messages:
morgan: Quick sync — want to expand inference-api sts from 3 -> 5 replicas and switch to the new KMS-backed secret for model keys. Main asks: is it safe to do this purely via Terraform k8s manifests, or should we do a manual staggered canary?

riley: What's the main risk you care about? PV provisioning delays, cluster quota, or sudden traffic spike during model load?

morgan: All three. New PVCs will be created for ordinals 3 and 4. If PD quota is tight or provisioning is slow we could hit long startup times and increase error rates. Also we want the new secret mount to be validated on the new pods before touching the old ones.

sam: I suggest using StatefulSet.rollingUpdate.partition to control which ordinals get updated first. Plan: bump replicas to 5, set partition to current replicas (3), then manually decrement partition after smoke checks so pods 3 and 4 come up with the new pod template.

carla: Agreed. StorageClass matters — our fast NVMe class is nvme-fast and has limited spare capacity. Example patch flow: apply TF change that updates replicas and podTemplate (secretRef + readiness change) but keep partition=3. Then manually patch partition down 3->2->1->0 once each step passes validation.

morgan: Can you paste the exact kubectl patch we should run to advance the partition?

carla: Sure, run: 
kubectl patch statefulset inference-api -n infra -p '{"spec":{"updateStrategy":{"rollingUpdate":{"partition":2}}}}'
Then repeat setting partition=1 then partition=0.

riley: Note PVC names will be inference-data-inference-api-3, -4. Ops should confirm PD quota and also whether thin-provisioned volumes will actually be allocated immediately.

ops-oncall: Checking now. Current regional PD quota (us-west1) total 3Ti, used ~2.35Ti. Creating two 250Gi volumes will keep us under hard quota but will reduce slack. Provisioning observed time ~180-240s historically for nvme-fast. I'll be on watch during the window.

sam: Also tweak readinessProbe — model loading into GPU can take a while. Current readiness is HTTP /health ready with initialDelaySeconds=15. Increase to 75 and failureThreshold=8 during rollout to avoid churn.

morgan: I'll include that in the manifest changes. Anything for lifecycle hooks?

carla: Add a preStop that calls our graceful shutdown script to let the model process flush caches and deregister from routing:

lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "./scripts/graceful_quit.sh || true"]

riley: One more thing: if you do replicas change via Terraform k8s_manifest resource, the state will reflect replicas but the partition manual changes won't be in TF. That's fine — we want manual control. Make sure PR includes a runbook section describing the manual patch sequence and the smoke tests to run after each step.

morgan: Good. Which smoke checks do we run after each partition decrement?

sam: Basic checks: pod Ready status, /health and /metrics responding, quick inference on a small prompt to ensure model loads to GPU, and pod logs for OOM or disk errors. Also check node disk iops and watch kubelet events for PVC attach errors.

carla: I'll add a small script examples in the PR:

# smoke.sh
kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -o wide
kubectl exec -it inference-api-3 -- curl -sS localhost:8080/health || exit 1
python tools/quick_infer.py --host inference-api-3:8080 --prompt "hello"

morgan: Ops, can you monitor PD quota and provisioning during the rollout window? We plan to do this at 20:00 UTC.

ops-oncall: I'll watch quotas and share ETA if any provisioning stalls. I'll also tail CSI driver logs.

devops-bot: [deploybot] PR opened: infra/inference-api-replicas-to-5 (https://git.redwood/infrapr/789) — includes manifest changes (replicas, readiness, secretRef, lifecycle). CI ran and basic lint passed.

sam: I'll review the TF k8s_manifest bits and add comments. Note: run kubectl get sc nvme-fast -o yaml to confirm allowVolumeExpansion and reclaimPolicy so we know how deletes behave.

riley: FYI reclaimPolicy is Delete for nvme-fast, allowVolumeExpansion: true. Noted.

morgan: Action list:
- sam: finish TF review + sign off (today)
- carla: add preStop and readiness changes in PR, include smoke script and runbook steps
- ops-oncall: monitor quota + provisioning at 20:00 UTC
- morgan: apply TF change, then perform partition patches 3->2->1->0 with smoke checks between steps

carla: I'll push the small manifest tweaks and update the PR description with the manual partition steps.

sam: Approved the PR comments; left a runbook snippet. :thumbsup:

morgan: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up in this thread with timing and when I start the manual partition advances.
